scientific_scope: mandatory pre-manuscript closure of the strongest-baseline and latency-tail weaknesses identified after commit 2f67a32
claim_boundary: The original broad FIBER-GRAND and generic fiber-guesswork claims remain withdrawn
The L0 oracle theorem is an interface-relative query theorem, not processor-cycle optimality
The fixed-edit method remains XP rather than FPT in edit count

stop_rule: Stop or narrow immediately if exactness fails, the feasible syndrome-trellis baseline removes the advantage, or the advantage is confined to zero-substitution blocks and disappears on positive-error strata.
